title: Review open-source harnesses for presentation-agent
measurement_note: Timing record started after web-first intake and some local context inspection, so early phases are explicitly marked as not measured.

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before the timing record was created; searches covered LLM eval, browser/visual/accessibility, and presentation-specific benchmarks.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Completed before the timing record was created.

phases.label: Mode, boundary, and plan
phases.bottleneck_notes: Selected standard mode because the work changed durable presentation-agent requirements and specs.

phases.label: Requirements and spec
phases.bottleneck_notes: Added REQ-PA-014, harness candidate config, research docs, workflow, web search record, and spec artifacts.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Updated request summaries, work summaries, and request trace without adding runtime dependencies.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Ran presentation-agent tests, catalog validation, config contract, workspace index, Workspace Monitor collect/check/test/build, governance health, grounding, and evaluation checks.

phases.label: Evaluation and rework
phases.bottleneck_notes: Grounding initially needed source_type rework, then passed after the evidence schema fix; evaluation report was written.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Will be completed after evaluator passes.

bottleneck_analysis.interpretation: The longest measured phase was verification because the task updated project docs, settings, specs, maps, monitoring snapshots, and evaluator artifacts, then reran both project and governance checks.
improvement_candidates: Implement the no-install quality harness next so future harness reviews can be validated with a deterministic command.
Create an installation audit template for Playwright/axe-core before adding browser dependencies.
